field_edits.updated_text: Mild diffuse osseous demineralization is present. No acute fracture or focal lesion is identified.

Mild degenerative changes of the acromioclavicular joint are seen. Glenohumeral joint space is relatively maintained. No dislocation is seen. The remaining joint spaces and articular margins are preserved.
No focal soft tissue abnormality or radiopaque foreign body is identified. The soft tissues are unremarkable.

impression:
